title: Eradication of MRSA biofilms using amphiphilic cationic coumarin derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25510-25513
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04358A, Paper
Open Access

Samuel O. Nitschke, Muhammed Awad, Alysha G. Elliott, Gabrielle Lowe, Chris Leigh, Ken Neubauer, Nicky Thomas, Shane M. Hickey, Sally E. Plush
A small series of cationic coumarin amphiphiles, designed to mimic antimicrobial peptides, eradicate MRSA biofilms and show promise as potential antibiofilm agents.
